title: Objective, Socratic quest, ideation, and dummy worlds
description: RelOp-only exploration. The SLM proposes binds. The grammar rejects illegal thoughts. The dummy sandbox picks a winner. Never SQL.

sota.title: Socratic Self-Refine
sota.use: Objective → explicit (sub-question, sub-answer) pairs. Here each pair is a named composite, executed on the dummy.

sota.title: HypeR / HypDB what-if
sota.use: Intervention is a query-time CASE rewrite, not a live UPDATE. vs_world compares observed vs intervened.

sota.title: LINX goal-oriented ADE
sota.use: Enumerate legal composite patterns, bind to the graph, rank by sandbox score. causal_explore is this loop over causal RelOps.

sota.title: QueRIE query log
sota.use: AskLog is the act relation: question, RelOp hash, ticket, status. The actuator may scan it.
